how to best evaluate mobile communication technology in the context of connectivist learning, as well as the implications of such an evaluation.
how we can re-evaluate our perception of mobile technology and how we can use such a re-evaluation to inform our approach to learning.
how we can better understand our use of mobile communication technology in order to improve the learning experience.

the re-evaluation proposed in this paper would provide us with a better understanding of the technology we use, and would therefore provide us with a more accurate perception of the technology.
mobile communication technologies have the potential to be used in connectivist learning, but that the evaluation of such technology is of the utmost importance.

this study has provided a theoretical framework for re-evaluation of user perception of technology in connectivist learning, and has provided the foundation for future research in the field of mobile communication technology and learning.

this study proposes a theoretical framework for evaluating the user perception of mobile communications technology, with regards to its use in connectivist learning, and the implications that this re-evaluation may have for education as a whole.
we are able to evaluate the perception of mobile communication technologies and the implications of this evaluation for connectivist learning and educational technology as a whole.
the re-evaluation process is necessary for the advancement of learning in the 21st century.

we should be more critical of our use of technology, as it is a tool for learning, and not the sole means of learning itself.
the technology we use to facilitate connectivist learning is not only important in itself, but also in its ability to facilitate the learning of the technology we are utilizing.
technology should be considered a part of learning and that the evaluation of technology should be considered in conjunction with the evaluation of the learning itself.
